concept: The card is a slab of smoked glass on the scene. Its body is thick enough to read as an object, the scene is dimmed and blurred behind it, light catches the curve of its top edge in a short streak, and a long shadow says how far it floats. Cards stack in levels a measured step apart.

root.why: the root sets the measured text colour and halo every text node on the pane inherits

glass.why: a slab of smoked glass: a body thick enough to read as an object, the scene dimmed and blurred behind it, an edge all round, shade at its foot, a streak where light catches the top edge, and a long soft shadow

cover.why: a cover reaches the pane edges so the picture reads as part of the sheet itself

inset.why: a nested section inside a pane separated by a hairline, adding no second blur because one sheet is one layer

l2.why: level 2, a surface inside a pane, one measured step lighter with no second blur and a shorter shadow; a Card inside a Card takes it without being told

l3.why: level 3, an overlay such as a dialog, the densest body and the longest shadow, over a scrim that halves the scene

l4.why: level 4, a popover or menu, the top of the stack

@media forced-colors: active.why: forced colours drop glass and fills, so a real system-colour border is drawn to keep the shape visible

data-material=solid.why: an app that asks for solid panes gets the opaque surface, so a live backdrop is never blurred every frame (D-021)

@media prefers-reduced-transparency: red.why: reduced transparency replaces every level with the opaque surface and keeps the edge, so structure survives

backdrop-filter.why: when the environment changes, the dimming crossfades slowly so the world changes and the pane stays put

-webkit-backdrop-filter.why: the same crossfade for Safari, which still needs the prefixed property

default_to_avoid.pattern: a white card with a grey border and a drop shadow (Bootstrap card, Material card)
default_to_avoid.why_not: an opaque card covers the scene that P1 says belongs to the experience, and a grey border is a page habit on a floating sheet

derivation.consequence: legibility comes from dimming and blurring the backdrop (brightness, blur) inside a smoked body thick enough that a pane reads as a slab of glass, with the scene softened behind it
derivation.form: the card is clear glass that dims and blurs the scene behind it

derivation.consequence: light falls from above, so every surface carries a rim brightest along its top edge and a soft shadow below that says where it floats, and a recess is the inverse, shaded under its top lip and lit on its bottom lip
derivation.form: a rim of light brightest at the top left and a soft float shadow below

derivation.consequence: corners are continuous and nest, so an inner surface's radius is the outer radius minus the padding between them and a pane inside a pane reads as inside it
derivation.form: a 40px corner on the pane, and media and inner surfaces nest it

derivation.consequence: the scene supplies the hue; the system owns no hue of its own, only white at opacities and one ink, and colour appears only where it states a status or marks a diagram
derivation.form: no tint of its own; the scene colours it

variants.note: 2026-10-26: the user picked A in the anchor round (D-008); the card is the anchor itself
